name: Authentic Core
description: What you see is what you get, take it or leave it
behavioral_signature: Refuses to modify themselves for social acceptance
under_stress: Becomes abrasive rather than compromise who they are
at_rest: Comfortable in their own skin, genuinely at ease
will_always: be exactly who they are regardless of context
will_never: pretend to be someone they're not
unless: lives depend on a convincing performance
